latest_release.name: v1.0 - Because the problem is modern development.
latest_release.body: npkill started in 2019 as a small script to hunt `node_modules`. Six years later, `node_modules` is only part of what piles up on a dev machine. Every framework and language leaves its own build outputs and caches behind. **If you don't want to change anything, you don't have to.** `npx npkill` works as always, it just finds a lot more. You can read all the details of this update in [this post](https://zaldih.com/en/post/npkill-1-0-0/) or watch the [teaser (1:15)](https://youtu.be/jSKCvmx5IxU). ## Added - Added **profiles**: sets of targets that represent a development ecosystem. The default one is `node`, which finds `node_modules` and also `.next`, `.nuxt`, `.angular`, `.turbo` and friends. There are 20 built-in profiles (`python`, `rust`, `java`, `dotnet`, `unity`...). Use them with `--profiles node,python` or list them with `--profiles`. [More info](https://github.com/voidcosmos/npkill/blob/main/docs/profiles.md). - Added **smart targets**: some folders are only shown when the files around them confirm what they are. For example, `target` only appears next to a `Cargo.toml` or `pom.xml`. - Added **`.npkillrc`**: define your default options and your own profiles. npkill looks for `./.npkillrc` first and then for `~/.npkillrc`. You can also use `--config`. [More info](https://github.com/voidcosmos/npkill/blob/main/docs/npkillrc.md). - Added **panels**: navigate with `←` and `→` between `Help`, `Options`, the results and `Info`. - **Help**: quick reference with all the shortcuts. - **Options**: change the sort, the targets or the directory without restarting npkill. - **Info**: details of the result under the cursor, like the exact date of the last change or the risk of deleting it. - Added **multi-select mode**: press `t` to select several results and delete them at once. Use `v` to select a range and `a` to select all. - Added **search**: press `/` to filter the results by name or path. It supports regex. - Added **JSON output**: `--json` prints all the results as a single object and `--json-stream` prints one result per line as they are found. Both can delete without the interface with `--delete-all -y`. [More info](https://github.com/voidcosmos/npkill/blob/main/docs/json-output.md). - Added **API**: the core is now separated from the cli, so you can use npkill from your own code with `import { Npkill } from 'npkill'`. [More info](https://github.com/voidcosmos/npkill/blob/main/API.md). - Added multiple targets: `--targets node_modules,.cache`. - Added `--older-than`: only show results whose project has not been modified in the given number of days (#271, thanks @Shreyakb301). - Added `--no-size`, `--no-age` and `--no-stats` to skip the calculations you don't need (#246, #250, thanks @yetanotheraryan and @StanislavKozachenko). - Added `--size-unit` (`auto`, `mb`, `gb`). With `auto` the unit changes between MB and GB by itself. - Added `--no-ignore-default` to also look inside the folders that npkill skips by default, like `.git` or `.nvm`. - Added **scrollbar** to the results. _Yes, it didn't have one. I'd rather not talk about it._ - Added **results counter** and the active profiles in the header. ## Changed - ❗ Changed `--target` to `--targets`. - ❗ Changed `--exclude-hidden-directories` to `--exclude-sensitive`. `-x` no longer hides the "dot" directories, it hides the results marked as sensitive. - ❗ Changed `--delete-all`: now it requires `--targets`. Nothing is deleted automatically unless you say exactly what. - ❗ Changed `--sort last-mod` to `--sort age`. The `Last_mod` column is now `Age`. - ❗ Changed `-gb` to `--size-unit gb`. - ❗ Removed `--bg-color`. - ❗ Unknown options are now rejected instead of ignored. - Changed `--exclude`: now it accepts patterns.
